product_name.value: Bharti AXA Life Dream Shield Plus
product_name.quote: Policy Document Bharti AXA Life Dream Shield Plus

irdai_description_line.value: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Savings, Life Insurance Plan
irdai_description_line.quote: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Savings, Life Insurance Plan
irdai_description_line.note: brochure prints "A Unit Linked, Non-Participating Individual Savings Life Insurance Plan"

policy_term_options.note: the brochure grid marks valid PT/PPT pairs with ticks that do not survive text extraction

ppt_options.value: limited 6, 7, 10, 12 years (no single or regular pay listed)
ppt_options.quote: The following Policy Terms and corresponding Premium Payment Terms (PPTs) are available under the product:
ppt_options.note: valid PT/PPT pairs: see the brochure grid on p.3

premium_min_annual.value: Rs 1,00,000 a year (annual mode); Rs 1,20,000 a year (other modes)

premium_max.value: no limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
premium_max.quote: No Limit, subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy

sum_assured_rule.value: annualised premium x death benefit multiple, minimum 8x; minimum sum assured Rs 8,00,000
sum_assured_rule.quote: The DBM is subject to a minimum of 8 times and a maximum subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy.

premium_modes.value: annual, half-yearly, quarterly, monthly (monthly through ECS/auto pay only)
premium_modes.quote: Premium Payment Modes available under the Policy are annual, half yearly, quarterly and monthly (payable through ECS only).

life_cover_multiple_choice.value: yes: DBM from 8x upwards, maximum per underwriting
life_cover_multiple_choice.quote: The DBM is subject to a minimum of 8 times and a maximum subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy.

premium_allocation_charge.quote: The Premium Allocation Charge shall be as per the tables below: Policy Year % of Annualised Premium 1 12% 2 6% 3 3% 4 3% 5+ NA

policy_administration_charge.value: none in years 1-4; from year 5, 0.50% of annualised premium per month, maximum Rs 500 per month
policy_administration_charge.quote: No Policy Administration Charge shall be applicable during the ﬁrst four Policy Years. The monthly Policy Administration Charge is 0.50% as a percentage of Annualized Premium.

fund_management_charge.quote: The above Charges (except for Discontinued Policy Fund) will not exceed the maximum cap prescribed by IRDAI which is currently 1.35% per annum.

mortality_charge.value: per 1000 sum at risk by attained age (table from age 18), monthly; guaranteed for the term; 3-year setback for female lives
mortality_charge.quote: The rates of Mortality Charges are guaranteed to remain the same during the Policy Term.
mortality_charge.note: table in the policy bond; returned in multiples from year 11

value.note: same for annualised premium up to and above Rs 50,000

discontinuance_charge.quote: The Discontinuance Charge is levied on the Unit Fund when the Policyholder opts for complete withdrawal/ Surrender or Discontinuance of the Policy.

switching_charge.quote: The Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

partial_withdrawal_charge.quote: In a Policy Year, the Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Partial Withdrawals free of charge

guarantee_charge.quote: There are no investment guarantees oﬀered under this Policy.

any_charge_returned.value: mortality charges returned in multiples from year 11 (see benefits.return_of_mortality_charges)
any_charge_returned.quote: Return of Mortality Charges shall not apply once the Policy is Surrendered, Discontinued or is in a Reduced Paid-up status.

death_benefit_formula.value: highest of: sum assured less partial withdrawals in the last 2 years; 105% of premiums paid less those withdrawals; fund value
death_benefit_formula.quote: The Death Beneﬁt will be highest of: a) Sum Assured less Applicable Partial Withdrawals*; or b) 105% of Total Premiums Paid as on date of death less Applicable Partial Withdrawal*; or

maturity_benefit.value: fund value; no investment guarantee; settlement option
maturity_benefit.quote: The Maturity Beneﬁt will be equal to the Policy Fund Value as on the date of maturity

value.name: Loyalty Booster at maturity, % of the 3-year average fund value

loyalty_additions.quote: The Loyalty Booster shall be added to the Policy as a percentage of the average Policy Fund Value of the three (3) years preceding the Maturity Date depending upon the Policy Term.

wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.quote: the Milestone Beneﬁt will be credited to the Fund at the end of each of the applicable policy years during the Policy Term until 5 years preceding to the maturity.

return_of_mortality_charges.value: from year 11, monthly: each month's mortality charge is returned 120 months later, at 1x (years 11-20, of charges from years 1-10), 2x (years 21-30) and 3x (years 31-40)
return_of_mortality_charges.quote: Policy Years Multiple of Mortality Charges 1 to 10 years Nil 11 to 20 years 1 time of the Mortality Charges collected during the 1st to 10th Policy Year.

fund_switching.quote: The Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

premium_redirection.value: allowed for future premiums, minimum 5% per fund
premium_redirection.quote: The Investment Fund Allocation Instruction is subject to a minimum Allocation percentage in a chosen Investment Fund/s, which is currently 5%.

partial_withdrawals.value: after the 5-year lock-in; minimum Rs 5,000; fund must stay at least 120% of AP; any number free
partial_withdrawals.quote: ii. The minimum Partial Withdrawal limit is Rs. 5,000/-.

systematic_withdrawal_plan.value: Systematic Withdrawal Benefit: annual, from year 10, up to one AP, minimum Rs 5,000; sum assured must stay at least 8x AP
systematic_withdrawal_plan.quote: SWB will start from 10th Policy Year or thereafter;

settlement_option.value: lump sum, instalments over up to 5 years, or a mix; cover during settlement is 105% of premiums paid
settlement_option.quote: The ‘Settlement Period’ is the period not exceeding ﬁve (5) years commencing from the Maturity Date and is an option available to the Policyholder at maturity.

policy_loan.quote: 13. Loan There is no provision of loan on the Policy.

value.name: Dynamic Fund Allocation
value.mechanics: Grow Money Plus Fund moving to Steady Money Fund over the last 5 years

value.name: Systematic Transfer Plan
value.mechanics: premium to Safe Money Fund, moved monthly to Grow Money Plus Fund; annual mode only

auto_portfolio_strategies.quote: If the Systematic Transfer Plan is opted, then the Company will automatically allocate the Premiums received (after deducting Premium Allocation Charges) to purchase Units in the Safe Money Fund.

fund_count.value: 8 funds plus the Discontinued Policy Fund
fund_count.quote: The eight (8) Investment Funds currently oﬀered under the Policy by the Company are -Growth Opportunities Plus Fund, Grow Money Plus Fund, Save'n'grow Money Fund, Steady Money Fund, Safe Money Fund, Build India Fund, Stability Plus Money Fund, and Emerging Equity Fund.

fund_list.quote: Growth Opportunities Plus Fund 1.35% per annum Grow Money Plus Fund 1.35% per annum Build India Fund 1.35% per annum
fund_list.note: same fund set and FMCs as Wealth Pro

index_or_thematic_funds.value: Build India Fund (infrastructure), Emerging Equity Fund (mid cap); no index fund
index_or_thematic_funds.quote: To provide long term capital appreciation through investing in a portfolio of mid cap companies.

accidental_death.value: Bharti AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider (130A012V02)
accidental_death.quote: Bharti AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider 130A012V02

value.name: Bharti AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider

riders_available.quote: Bharti AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider 130A012V02
riders_available.note: the brochure's rider section names "Growth Shield Plus" instead of Dream Shield Plus

lock_in_years.quote: Upon Your request, Policy can be completely withdrawn/Surrendered during Lock-in Period of ﬁve (5) years.

discontinuance_rules.value: in lock-in: fund less discontinuance charge to the Discontinued Policy Fund (4% p.a. minimum), cover stops; after lock-in: reduced paid-up unless revived or withdrawn
discontinuance_rules.quote: Upon expiry of the Grace Period, in case of Discontinuance of Policy due to non-payment of Premium, the Policy Fund Value after deducting the applicable Discontinuance Charges shall be credited to the Discontinued Policy Fund and the risk cover and Rider cover, if any, shall cease.

revival_period.quote: provide the option to revive the Policy within the Revival Period of three (3) years as per the terms and conditions of this Policy Document.

surrender_value_rule.value: in lock-in: fund less discontinuance charge, paid after year 5; after lock-in: fund value
surrender_value_rule.quote: Upon Your request, Policy can be completely withdrawn/Surrendered during Lock-in Period of ﬁve (5) years.
